column7: structural half of stale-secret-save-001/002/003 (#2695), a DERIVED sweep rather than a per-function guard: it walks every non-test file under internal/core, internal/storage/store and server/ and asserts nothing calls a storage method named UpdateSecret. The full-row primitive itself was deleted by STORE-UPDATESECRET-RETIRE-1, so the compiler now rejects a caller of the interface method and this sweep is the by-name backstop against a re-added UpdateSecret storage method (in server/ it recognises only receivers reached through Storage(), narrower than the deleted per-receiver sweep; see its doc comment). It discriminates a storage handle from the identically-named exported core method c.UpdateSecret by RECEIVER shape (stated in the test's doc comment). Companions: TestUpdateSecretWrites_AreColumnScoped (the LocalStorage body plus all eight call sites) and TestUpdateSecretRequest_FieldSetsMatch (applyUpdateSecretFields and secretFieldUpdateFromRequest must read the same request fields, since a field wired into only one is silently either never-persisted or not-reflected)
